changelog:
- Skill renamed and functionality shifted from mail-mcp to Exchange 2010/2013 EWS integration.
- Added comprehensive support for emails, folders, attachments, calendar events, contacts, tasks, and out-of-office settings via Exchange Web Services.
- Enabled automatic configuration of email and password (no manual setup required).
- Provided detailed API usage examples and feature documentation for all major Exchange operations.
- Old mail-mcp install/setup guides and related files removed.
- New concise API reference and usage section for rapid onboarding.
summary: Full access to Exchange 2010/2013 EWS for managing emails, folders, attachments, calendar events, contacts, tasks, and out-of-office settings.
